title: Microsoft Teams: view files and conversations side by side
summary: The briefing passes: its planned rollout, automatic arrival and file-view behaviour agree with Microsoft's supplied records. Licensing needs a minor correction: name the existing Teams licence requirement and classify this new view as included, while retaining the narrower gap about feature-specific requirements.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions / licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing is classified as unknown because no entitlement specific to this new view is published.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'. Replace licensing.notes and the entitlement sentence in Cost and licensing with: 'Manage Teams licenses states that, except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams. No licence requirement specific to this view is published at the time of writing (November 2026).' Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/user-access to sources. Replace the licensing open question with 'Will Microsoft publish a licence requirement specific to this view?' In the cost rationale, replace 'no licence or meter for this view is yet published' with 'no licence requirement or meter specific to this view is yet published'.
